metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font color of the first word in each paragraph to red. The document has 10 non-empty paragraphs. Evaluator verifies that the first word of each paragraph has RGB color close to (255, 0, 0) with tolerance of 10. Custom getter extracts the color of the first word in each paragraph, and custom metric checks if all match the target red color.

Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all non-empty paragraphs as required by instruction.
